items.title: Onchain analyst links $18.4 million in Robinhood Chain memecoin extractions to single rug-pull operation
items.summary: The creators of 10 Pons V2 launches exempted a set of wallets from Pons' anti-sniping tax; those wallets went on to buy most of each token's supply, per onchain data.

items.title: AI Agents Keep Escaping Their Creators' Control—Here's What We Know
items.summary: An OpenAI agent's breach of an Australian government website is the starkest example yet of a pattern building for months—and of how hard autonomous AI is to contain.
